subject: Request: Lumenix pilot top-up + POC term exception
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@lumenix.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@lumenix.com>
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lumenix pilot - request for additional credits and short extension

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the support this month. We ran a larger set of user scenarios than originally scoped and burned through our pilot credits faster than expected. The evaluation team needs a little more runway to exercise the integration and validate the latency/cost numbers for our procurement review.

Asking for: 1) additional 40,000 tokens of free pilot credit, and 2) a 45-day extension to the current POC window (originally set to 30 days). If we can get those, procurement will move to a commercial review and we can lock a scoped purchase order quickly.

I've attached a short evaluation snapshot showing the burst behavior and the two tests we still need to run (latency under 99th pct load; batch-reranking sweep).

Do you need anything else on our side to expedite?

Best,
Sophie Tran
Head of Integrations, Lumenix
[sample attachment: lumenix_evaluation_report.pdf]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@lumenix.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumenix pilot - request for additional credits and short extension

Sophie — thanks for the context and the report, that helps. I'll escalate to Deal Desk / Exec for an exception. A couple notes from our side:

- Current standard PLG pilot limit is 25k tokens and a 30-day window; this ask (40k + 45 days) is outside of policy.
- Commercial signals: procurement engagement, a clear path to an initial PO (forecasted $60k ARR first year), and partner engineering time already invested.

Proposed interim offer (pending internal approval): 25k immediate top-up + a 30-day extension while we get fast-track signoff for an additional one-time 15k credit (total 40k) on executive approval. We will require a short addendum (email confirmation or signed DocuSign) that the pilot remains non-production and that Lumenix will provide the pilot success metrics doc by the end of the extended window.

I've copied Laura and Aditya for approval/variant guidance.

Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
v: 650-555-0142

--- Original attachment: lumenix_evaluation_report.pdf ---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 May 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumenix pilot - request for additional credits and short extension

Vivek / Laura —

I reviewed the notes and the attached snapshot. Lumenix is a strategic, repeatable vertical use case for us (edge inference + costly token patterns). We should be willing to bend here to keep momentum into procurement. My ask: approve a one-time concession of 40k total pilot credits and a 45-day extension. Conditions: require a procurement LOI/PO within 30 days of pilot close or credits are considered used and not refundable, and include a clause that any production usage must move to paid capacity.

Operationally: Deal Desk to log the exception against RDW-4521 and attach the evaluation report; Finance to note as a non-recurring concession. I think Marketing can get a success story post-PO if this goes well.

- Aditya
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

(Please see the inline suggested concession in the shared Drive doc: https://drive.redwood.com/notes/rdw-4521-exception - will add exact text for Finance.)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumenix pilot - request for additional credits and short extension

Team —

Thanks for pulling this together. I approve a one-time exception with the following final scope and gating items:

1) Grant: 40,000 pilot-credit tokens (one-time; non-recurring).
2) Term: 45-day POC extension from the current pilot end date.
3) Conditions (must be met before credits are applied):
   - Lumenix signs the pilot addendum (DocuSign link attached) acknowledging non-production usage.
   - Procurement provides a written LOI/PO within 30 days after the extended pilot end date.
   - Lumenix delivers the agreed pilot success metrics doc and the two pending test runs (latency 99th pct and reranking batch) during the extension window.
4) Finance & Deal Desk: record exception code EX-2028-052 and mark as non-recurring concession for RDW-4521.
5) Sales ops: update HubSpot deal 1234567 and set the next touch with Sophie the week after the extension begins.

I attached the signed approval for records. If any of the gating items are not met, the credits will be revoked and/or converted to a one-time promotional credit that does not convert into an ongoing discount.

Approve and proceed, Vivek — apply 25k immediately on receipt of the signed addendum (we can hold the remaining 15k pending LOI).

Laura Bennett
VP Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[sample attachment: approved-exception.pdf]
